title: Synchronous pauses: shared drive vs fixed coupling
question: When Purkinje cells pause together during the reach, is it shared drive only, shared drive amplified by fixed couplings, or beyond the fixed pairwise model?
headline: INCONCLUSIVE (pre-registered). Couplings create synchronous pauses at rest (21/21, ~+20% over rates; fixed-J model accounts for it); no consistent extra pause at peak acceleration (12/21). Fixed J predicts a reach-time drop in the coupling excess that the data match vs baseline but not vs a rest control (post hoc); driven by 2022 cohort.
